annotations.title: Weather forecast today: any city, 48 hours

description: Weather forecast today for any city or coordinates: current temperature, conditions, rain, wind and humidity now, plus an hourly forecast up to 48 hours ahead (MET Norway data). Give a city such as London or lat and lon. Use for travel, events, logistics or a daily brief. Example: city=London. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

city.description: City or place name, e.g. London or Tokyo (used when lat and lon are not given)

hours.description: Hours of hourly forecast to return, 1-48 (default 12; 48 covers tomorrow)

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, -90 to 90 (with lon, instead of city)

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, -180 to 180 (with lat, instead of city)

name: weather_today
title: Weather forecast today: any city, 48 hours
